description_zh: 根据配置创建工作流实例，如补数据工作流实例

name: CreateWorkflowInstances

parameters.help_en:
The project environment. Valid values:

- Prod

- Dev
parameters.help_zh:
项目环境。
- Prod：生产
- Dev：开发
parameters.name: env_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the workflow to which the instance belongs. This parameter is set to 1 for auto triggered tasks
parameters.help_zh: 所属工作流的ID。周期任务的WorkflowId均为1
parameters.name: workflow_id

element_fields.help_en: The data timestamp at which the data starts to be backfilled. Configure this parameter in the `yyyy-mm-dd` format
element_fields.name: start_biz_date

element_fields.help_en: The data timestamp at which data is no longer backfilled. Configure this parameter in the `yyyy-mm-dd` format
element_fields.name: end_biz_date

fields.help_en: The data timestamps. You can specify up to seven data timestamps
fields.help_zh: 业务日期列表。可指定多段业务日期（最多7段）
fields.name: biz_dates

fields.help_en:
The start time of data backfill. Configure this parameter in the `hh:mm:ss` format. The time must be in the 24-hour clock. Default value: 00:00:00.

If you configure this parameter, you must also configure the EndTime parameter
fields.help_zh:
指定开始周期时间，格式为`hh:mm:ss`，24小时制，默认00:00:00。

如果填写此字段需要StartTime与EndTime需要同时填写
fields.name: start_time

fields.help_en:
The end time of data backfill. Configure this parameter in the `hh:mm:ss` format. The time must be in the 24-hour clock. Default value: 23:59:59.

If you configure this parameter, you must also configure the StartTime parameter
fields.help_zh:
指定结束周期时间，格式为`hh:mm:ss`，24小时制，默认23:59:59。

如果填写此字段需要StartTime与EndTime需要同时填写
fields.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The configuration of the data backfilling period
parameters.name: periods

parameters.help_en:
The type of the workflow instance. Valid values:

- SupplementData: Data backfill. The usage of RootTaskIds and IncludeTaskIds varies based on the backfill mode. See the description of the DefaultRunProperties.Mode parameter.

- ManualWorkflow: Manually triggered workflow. WorkflowId is required for a manual workflow. RootTaskIds is optional. If not specified, the system uses the default root task list of the manual workflow.

- Manual: Manual task. You only need to specify RootTaskIds. This is the list of manual tasks to run.

- SmokeTest: Smoke test. You only need to specify RootTaskIds. This is the list of test tasks to run.

- TriggerWorkflow: Triggered Workflow You must specify the WorkflowId of the triggered workflow. IncludeTaskIds is optional. If you do not specify IncludeTaskIds, the entire workflow runs
parameters.help_zh:
工作流实例的类型。

- SupplementData：补数据。RootTaskIds与IncludeTaskIds的填写方法随补数据模式而变化，见DefaultRunProperties.Mode参数说明
- ManualWorkflow：手动业务流程。WorkflowId需要填手动业务流程的WorkflowId，RootTaskIds选填，不填则会使用手动业务流程默认的根节点列表。
- Manual：手动任务。仅需填RootTaskIds，即为要运行的手动任务列表。
- SmokeTest：冒烟测试。仅需填RootTaskIds，即为要运行的测试任务列表。
- TriggerWorkflow：触发式工作流。WorkflowId需要填触发式工作流的WorkflowId，IncludeTaskIds选填，不填则会运行整个工作流
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The workflow parameters. This parameter takes effect when a specific workflow is specified (`WorkflowId != 1`). For scheduled workflows and triggered workflows, the format is key=value, and these parameters have lower priority than task parameters. For manual workflows, the format is JSON, and these parameters have higher priority than task parameters
parameters.help_zh: 工作流参数，当指定唯一工作流（`WorkflowId != 1`）时生效。若为周期工作流、触发式工作流，格式为key=value，优先级低于任务参数；若为手动业务流程，格式为JSON，优先级高于任务参数
parameters.name: workflow_parameters

parameters.help_en: The task-specific parameters. The value is in the JSON format. The key specifies the task ID. You can call the GetTask operation to obtain the format of the value by querying the script parameters
parameters.help_zh: 任务参数，为特定任务设置参数。JSON格式，key为任务ID，value的格式参考任务脚本参数（GetTask接口的结果Task.Script.Parameter）
parameters.name: task_parameters

parameters.help_zh: 创建后是否直接运行，默认为true
parameters.name: auto_start_enabled

fields.help_en:
The list of root task IDs.

- When Type is set to SupplementData, RootTaskIds is required unless Mode is set to Chain.

- When Type is set to ManualWorkflow, RootTaskIds is optional. If it is not specified, the default root nodes of the manual workflow are used.

- When Type is set to Manual, RootTaskIds is required and specifies the list of manual tasks to run.

- When Type is set to SmokeTest, RootTaskIds is required and specifies the list of test tasks to run
fields.help_zh:
根任务ID列表。

- Type=SupplementData时。除Mode=Chain的情况外，RootTaskIds均必填。
- Type=ManualWorkflow时。RootTaskIds选填，不填则会使用手动业务流程默认的根节点列表。
- Type=Manual时。RootTaskIds必填，即为要运行的手动任务列表。
- Type=SmokeTest时：RootTaskIds必填，即为要运行的测试任务列表
fields.name: root_task_ids

fields.help_en: The IDs of the tasks to run
fields.help_zh: 需要运行的任务ID列表
fields.name: include_task_ids

fields.help_en: The IDs of the tasks not to run
fields.help_zh: 不要运行的任务ID列表
fields.name: exclude_task_ids

fields.help_en: The IDs of the projects to run
fields.help_zh: 需要运行的项目ID列表
fields.name: include_project_ids

fields.help_en: The IDs of the projects not to run
fields.help_zh: 不需要运行的项目ID列表
fields.name: exclude_project_ids

fields.help_en:
The data backfill mode. Default value: ManualSelection. Required when Type is set to SupplementData.

- General: You can specify only one value for `RootTaskIds`. The `IncludeTaskIds` parameter is optional. If it's not specified, it defaults to including `RootTaskIds`.

- ManualSelection: You can specify multiple values for `RootTaskIds`. The `IncludeTaskIds` parameter is optional. If it is not specified, it defaults to including `RootTaskIds`.

- Chain: If you set the Mode parameter to Chain, leave the `RootTaskIds` parameter empty and set the `IncludeTaskIds` parameter to the start task ID and the end task ID.

- AllDownstream: Only one `RootTaskId` can be specified
fields.help_zh:
补数据模式，默认为ManualSelection。Type=SupplementData时必填。
- General：普通模式，`RootTaskIds`仅能填一个，`IncludeTaskIds`选填，不填会默认包含`RootTaskIds`中的内容
- ManualSelection：手动选择，`RootTaskIds`能填多个，`IncludeTaskIds`选填，不填会默认包含`RootTaskIds`中的内容
- Chain：链路，`RootTaskIds`为空，`IncludeTaskIds`填两个id，分别是起始和结束任务
- AllDownstream：所有下游，`RootTaskIds`仅能填一个
fields.name: mode

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable the analysis feature. Required when Type = SupplementData
fields.help_zh: 是否开启分析。Type=SupplementData时必填
fields.name: enabled

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to block execution if the analysis fails. Required when Type = SupplementData
fields.help_zh: 分析不通过的情况下是否阻塞运行。Type=SupplementData时必填
fields.name: blocked

fields.help_en: The analysis configuration. Required when Type = SupplementData
fields.help_zh: 分析配置。Type=SupplementData时必填
fields.name: analysis

fields.help_en: The start time of running. Configure this parameter in the `hh:mm:ss` format (24-hour clock). This parameter is required if you configure the RunPolicy parameter
fields.help_zh: 开始运行时间，格式为`hh:mm:ss`，24小时制。若设置运行策略，此字段必填
fields.name: start_time

fields.help_en: The end time of running. Configure this parameter in the `hh:mm:ss` format (24-hour clock). This parameter is required if you configure the RunPolicy parameter. Valid values:
fields.help_zh: 结束运行时间，格式为`hh:mm:ss`，24小时制。若设置运行策略，此字段必填
fields.name: end_time

fields.help_en:
The time period type. This parameter is required if you configure the RunPolicy parameter. Valid values:

- Daily

- Weekend
fields.help_zh:
时段类型。若设置运行策略，此字段必填。
- Daily：每天
- Weekend：仅周末
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: Specifies whether a task whose scheduled run time is in the future can be run immediately. Default value: false
fields.help_zh: 运行时间在未来是否可以立即运行起来，默认为false
fields.name: immediately

fields.help_en: The run policy. If the parameter is left empty, the task configuration is used
fields.help_zh: 运行策略。该字段为空则跟随任务配置
fields.name: run_policy

fields.help_en:
The alerting policy. Valid values:

- Success: Alerts on success.

- Failure: Alerts on failure.

- SuccessFailure: Alerts on both success and failure
fields.help_zh:
报警策略。
- Success 成功告警
- Failure 失败告警
- SuccessFailure 成功和失败都告警
fields.name: type

fields.help_en:
The alert notification method. Valid values:

- Sms: SMS only.

- Mail: Mail only.

- SmsMail: SMS and mail
fields.help_zh:
通知方式。
- Sms：仅短信
- Mail：仅邮件
- SmsMail：短信加邮件
fields.name: notice_type

fields.help_en: The alert settings
fields.help_zh: 报警配置
fields.name: alert

fields.help_en: The task concurrency. Values from 2 to 10 indicate concurrency. A value of 1 indicates sequential execution. Required when Type = SupplementData
fields.help_zh: 任务并行数。取值2~10时为并行度， 取值1时为串行。Type=SupplementData时必填
fields.name: parallelism

fields.help_en:
The execution order. Default value: Asc.

- Asc: ascending by business date.

- Desc: descending by business date
fields.help_zh:
运行顺序，默认为Asc。
- Asc：按业务日期升序。
- Desc：按业务日期降序
fields.name: order

fields.help_en: The custom scheduling resource group ID. If left empty, the task configuration is used
fields.help_zh: 自定义调度资源组标识符，该字段为空则跟随任务配置
fields.name: runtime_resource

fields.help_en: The execution priority, range: 1–11. A higher value indicates higher priority
fields.help_zh: 运行优先级，取值范围为1~11。取值越大，优先级越高。（该参数配置只支持手动业务流程与触发式工作流）
fields.name: priority

fields.help_en:
The priority weighting policy.

- `Disable` (default): Do not enable.

- `Upstream`: The priority is based on the total weight of upstream nodes. The deeper the hierarchy, the higher the weight
fields.help_zh:
优先级权重策略。（该参数配置只支持手动业务流程与触发式工作流）
- `Disable`：不启用（默认）
- `Upstream`：当前节点计算上游的权重总和。即层次越深，权重越高
fields.name: priority_weight_strategy

parameters.help_en:
The tag creation policy. Valid values:

- Append: New tags are added on top of the existing tags of the manual workflow.

- Overwrite: Existing tags of the manual workflow are not inherited. New tags are created directly
parameters.help_zh:
标签创建策略。
- Append：追加模式，在继承手动业务流程已有标签的基础上追加新的标签。
- Overwrite：覆盖模式，不继承手动业务流程已有标签，直接创建标签
parameters.name: tag_creation_policy
